payload.model_patch:
diff --git a/django/db/models/deletion.py b/django/db/models/deletion.py
index 92fe4affb9..c3e757e6a2 100644
--- a/django/db/models/deletion.py
+++ b/django/db/models/deletion.py
@@ -321,6 +321,11 @@ class Collector:
             for (field, value), instances in instances_for_fieldvalues.items():
                 for obj in instances:
                     setattr(obj, field.attname, value)
+        for model, instances in self.data.items():
+            for instance in instances:
+                setattr(instance, model._meta.pk.attname, None)
+        # Update the PK on the instances that were directly deleted
+        # (not via fast_deletes or field_updates).
         for model, instances in self.data.items():
             for instance in instances:
                 setattr(instance, model._meta.pk.attname, None)

diff --git a/django/db/models/deletion.py b/django/db/models/deletion.py
index 92fe4affb9..121719d776 100644
--- a/django/db/models/deletion.py
+++ b/django/db/models/deletion.py
@@ -324,4 +324,10 @@ class Collector:
         for model, instances in self.data.items():
             for instance in instances:
                 setattr(instance, model._meta.pk.attname, None)
+        # fast_deletes won't have their PKs cleared by the loop above,
+        # so handle them here.
+        for qs in self.fast_deletes:
+            model = qs.model
+            for obj in qs:
+                setattr(obj, model._meta.pk.attname, None)
         return sum(deleted_counter.values()), dict(deleted_counter)

diff --git a/django/db/models/deletion.py b/django/db/models/deletion.py
index 92fe4affb9..c433fec340 100644
--- a/django/db/models/deletion.py
+++ b/django/db/models/deletion.py
@@ -324,4 +324,9 @@ class Collector:
         for model, instances in self.data.items():
             for instance in instances:
                 setattr(instance, model._meta.pk.attname, None)
+        # fast_deletes may have been added for instances with no dependencies
+        for qs in self.fast_deletes:
+            model = qs.model if hasattr(qs, 'model') else type(qs)
+            for instance in qs:
+                setattr(instance, model._meta.pk.attname, None)
         return sum(deleted_counter.values()), dict(deleted_counter)
